title: SecHelix calibration record v1
description: How well stated confidence predicted the independent verifier's outcome. A calibration record is a claim about the reviewer, so it obeys the same evidence rules as a claim about code: it is NOT_MEASURED until enough uncontaminated samples exist, and it names its own contamination.

measurement_status.description: MEASURED only when sample_size >= minimum_sample_size AND contamination.is_contaminated is false. Any other combination is NOT_MEASURED, and every metric renders as the literal string NOT_MEASURED rather than a number.

minimum_sample_size.description: Below this, a bucket's observed rate is noise. Declared up front so the threshold cannot be lowered after seeing a result.

calibration_error.description: Mean absolute gap between stated confidence and observed verification rate, weighted by bucket size. A number only when measurement_status is MEASURED.

overconfident_buckets.description: Buckets whose observed verification rate falls materially below their stated confidence. These are the ones that produce false accusations.

underconfident_buckets.description: Buckets whose observed rate exceeds their stated confidence. These produce findings that were downgraded or discarded when they should not have been.

reason.description: Why the samples cannot be trusted, or NONE. A session that authored the fixtures it is being scored against is contaminated.

limitations.description: What would make a reader over-read this record. Required and non-empty, even when MEASURED.

confidence.description: The confidence vocabulary from finding-v1. NOT_ASSESSED is tracked but never scored: a finding that stated no confidence made no prediction to be right or wrong about.

stated_probability.description: The probability the label is taken to assert. Declared in the record so a reader can disagree with the mapping rather than guess it.

unresolved.description: Candidates whose verification did not complete. Counted separately and never folded into either side: an unresolved candidate is not evidence for or against the confidence that raised it.

observed_rate.description: verified / (verified + refuted). NOT_MEASURED when the bucket is below the minimum sample size or has no resolved samples.
